long_biography.plain_text:
A visit to neuroscientist Eric Kandel's laboratory helped inspire property developer Mortimer Zuckerman's support for brain research at Columbia University. He endowed the university's Mind Brain Behavior Institute, bringing researchers from different disciplines together to investigate memory, language, emotion and other functions. He described the gift as an investment in scholars and their collective work.

Zuckerman also founded the institute's Brain Trust, a voluntary advisory group intended to guide university leaders and scientists and raise public awareness of neuroscience. His endowment also backed collaboration between biological scientists and scholars working in mathematics, psychology and economics.
